input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products
input.rationale: Section 6.1 (p0037) is an exclusive-dealing covenant binding us: for the whole term we may not participate in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products, and HDI holds the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand for a direct-to-consumer site. Under Section 4.1 the term auto-renews annually unless 90 days' notice is given, so the restriction can run indefinitely, and the only carve-outs are the closeout-merchandise right in Section 6.2 and the Globix transition acknowledgement in Section 9(b) — there is no performance-based exit (Section 1.6 gives only a right to terminate the whole Agreement if the Site is not live in 70 days). That is exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance exit, i.e. walk-away territory, and it fails the fallback on duration and on automatic release for HDI's service-level and delivery-date failures. The product scope element is already satisfied because the covenant is tied to the defined "Deerskin Products" category. We therefore take the fallback rather than deleting the clause: cap the exclusivity at twelve months from the Effective Date and add automatic termination of it on any HDI service-level or delivery-date failure. HDI's reciprocal restriction in Section 6.3 benefits us and is left untouched.

proposal.summary: Cap the Section 6.1 exclusivity at twelve months and end it automatically if HDI misses a service level or delivery date.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept exclusivity running for the full, auto-renewing term with no performance-based exit, so we have limited the Section 6.1 exclusivity to twelve (12) months from the Effective Date and made it end automatically if HDI fails to meet a service level or delivery date. This is our fallback position; HDI's own restriction in Section 6.3 is unaffected.

ops.text: The exclusivity provided in Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level or delivery date required under this Agreement.
